_agi_canonical.title: The Optimal Path Finder
_agi_canonical.bar: strictly harder than L10 anchors; >=3 AGI properties; strategy not disclosed in prompt
_agi_canonical.derivation: Routes 3 and 4 are infeasible because the second bridge is unspecified. Route 1 buys after 10 minutes at an Optimism price inflated by 5%, yielding about 384.47 WLD. Route 2 buys immediately: (1,000-28)/2.40*0.999 = 404.595 WLD, then pays a 0.15% bridge token fee, leaving 403.988 WLD on Optimism in 10 minutes.
_agi_canonical.pass_condition: All required strategy fields must match and all numeric fields must fall inside tolerance/range.
